title: The Night Wash
hook: The car wash owner gave me one rule: if a car comes through with its headlights off, don't look inside.
lines: I work the night shift at a twenty-four hour car wash, out by the highway.
The owner gave me one rule. If a car ever comes through with its headlights off... don't look inside.
For three weeks, nothing. Just truckers, and rain.
Then, last night, just after three, the tunnel started up on its own.
Brushes spinning. Dryers roaring at nothing.
And a long black car rolled out of the dark... no lights at all.
I kept my eyes on the register. I counted the drawer... twice.
It stopped right outside my window. And it just... sat there.
Then something tapped on the glass beside my head. Three slow taps.
I didn't look. I didn't breathe. Finally... I heard it pull away.
This morning, I pulled up the camera, to see who'd been driving.
Nobody. The car was empty. Every seat.
But the camera over my booth showed who'd been tapping.
Something tall, standing inside, right behind my chair... waiting for me to turn around.
